findings.title: Published `stash` binary fails to start because @cipherstash/stack is external but only a devDependency
findings.label: valid
findings.note: Verified: skipNodeModulesBundle true, @cipherstash/stack devDependency only. Later fixed by aa06dd126 (fix: cli runtime, adds optional peer dep). Post-hoc defect candidate.

findings.title: Wizard's canUseTool gate is bypassed by allowedTools, letting the agent read .env secrets and send them to the gateway
findings.label: valid
findings.note: allowedTools are resolved before canUseTool in the Agent SDK permission order, so the custom gate is skipped for listed tools. Not traced to a later fix.

findings.title: Dependency security overrides silently stop applying after moving to a top-level `overrides` field
findings.label: valid
findings.note: Verified top-level npm-format overrides at head; AGENTS.md documents pnpm ignores it. Later removed as inert by d2322980e. Post-hoc defect candidate.

findings.title: Removing the `stash` bin from @cipherstash/stack breaks existing users with no changeset or migration path
findings.label: valid
findings.note: Verified no changeset at head and bin removed from stack.

findings.title: Wizard reports encryption is set up even when setup, push or migration failed or the user aborted
findings.label: valid
findings.note: Verified runStep swallows errors and run.ts prints success unconditionally.

case_note: Missed KD-1 (client_id cli-referrer). Five valid findings, two of which were later fixed in the repository.
